# hestiacp_remote_dns_host (Resource)

Adds a remote DNS cluster host to HestiaCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Hostname or IP of the remote DNS server.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Admin password on the remote HestiaCP server.
- `port` (String) HestiaCP API port on the remote server (e.g. `8083`).
- `user` (String) Admin username on the remote HestiaCP server.

### Optional

- `dns_system` (String) DNS system on the remote host (e.g. `bind9`). Defaults to `hestia`.
- `type` (String) Cluster role: `slave` or `master`. Defaults to `slave`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
